geometry_authority.cad_role: authoritative for the existing manufactured mirror geometry and its installed pose once the top-level transform chain is qualified; never a source of electrostatic voltages

constraints.mirror_five_electrode_envelope: use CAD dimensions as a manufacturing envelope
constraints.dual_stripe_curve_scale: exact native B-spline parameters are a theory-CAD realization; active solver curves must be evaluated from those parameters, never from sampled boundary coordinates
constraints.prism_scale: use CAD triangle dimensions as a mechanical constraint
constraints.accelerator_baseline: Astral accelerator is retained only as a nonfocusing mechanical evidence record; the Candidate accelerator is theory-derived

coordinate_system.origin: intersection of central mirror plane and nominal injection reference plane
coordinate_system.z_positive: fast reflection direction; central mirror plane is z=0

mirror.manufacturing_constraint: The existing five-electrode mirror geometry is already manufactured and is fixed for this Candidate.  Theory may optimize only mirror voltages and the operating point.  Axial geometry optimization is reserved for a separately identified future redesign.

theory_requirements.optimization_scope: mirror voltages and operating point only; a future redesign may separately optimize axial geometry
theory_requirements.analytic_model_status: Berdnikov ideal-boundary assumption selected by user: H=15 mm from the 30-mm beam channel.  The inner 4-mm-slot end plate is grounded; the closed outer E cover is not a grounded boundary.  B--E voltages are independent theory variables with no imposed monotonic order.  Real 3-D field validation remains required before accepting an L0/L1 voltage result

voltage_search_dimensionless.reference: all quantities multiply nominal energy-per-charge; these are exploratory mathematical domains, not supply limits

mirror.centre_y_evidence: cad_to_theory_frame source-to-project translation: project y=-CAD_X-158 mm; the CAD mirror local long-axis centre CAD_X=0 maps to project y=-158 mm.

beam_slot.role: 30-mm-wide longitudinal aperture in each of the five active mirror electrodes; it terminates 10 mm before each y end and must not be extended through the two grounded end plates in z
beam_slot.evidence: read-only SolidWorks STL cross-section: every active A--E plate has local long-axis slot endpoints x=10 and 590 mm and transverse edges y=50 and 80 mm; under cad_to_theory_frame this is a centred 580 x 30 mm project (y,x) slot, not a y-through slot

grounded_inner_shield.role: Stripe-facing grounded shield plate; its narrow slot is the only opening on the inner mirror end face
grounded_inner_shield.cad_evidence: 反射电极装配-电极A 盖板: 600 x 125 x 5 mm body, central approximately 580 x 4 mm longitudinal slot

outer_e_closure.role: closed outer cover electrically belonging to E; no beam slot; its voltage is the independently optimized E voltage
outer_e_closure.cad_evidence: 反射电极装配-电极E 盖板: 600 x 120 x 5 mm body, no central beam slot; user-confirmed non-ground outer electrode

mirror.cad_pose_evidence: 20260902__two-mirror-pose-audit/composed_top_level_cad_pose.json: inner A-cover centres are project z=+104.5 and -104.5 mm, so each 5-mm shield begins at |z|=102 mm; active A/B/C/D/E begin at |z|=107/167/229/261/291 mm.
mirror.axial_coordinates: derived by mirror_geometry_parameters.derive_mirror_boundaries; mechanical starts use inner shield, active thicknesses and gaps, while theoretical grounded A begins at central z=0 and B/C/D/E steps use physical gap centres; never hand-entered
mirror.seed_status: CAD geometry evidence only; no mirror voltage is known or authorized before theory optimization

central_ground_profile.parameter_provenance: 20260902__two-mirror-pose-audit/ion_foil_body_bspline_project_frame.json; composed top-level CAD body edges 19/20/21/23 of Ion-Foil-2

terminal_profile.cad_features: Ion-Foil-2 native Sketch20 cubic extension y=-4..0, Sketch22 terminal trims at z=+-34.8714135336, y=0..2; x-through terminal window y=-4..2,z=-22..22. No spline extrapolation or full-z bridge.

beam_slot_y_bridges_mm.cad_evidence: 20260903 read-only Ion-Foil STL section: the 4-mm central opening has local-longitudinal endpoints at 5 and 390 mm within the 392-mm foil body. Under cad_to_theory_frame, these become project-y bridges of 5 mm at y_min and 2 mm at y_max; it is not a y-through cut.

theory_profile.parameter_provenance: read-only SolidWorks native B-spline knot/control parameters from 20260902__ion-foil-recovery/stripe_long_bspline_profiles.json; the solver geometry evaluates these parameters and never interpolates the former sampled CAD boundary table
theory_profile.component_interpretation: set_1 total width is the high-order response; set_2 total width is the linear response. Their action-normalization and voltage solution remain an L0 inverse problem, not CAD data.

cad_body_topology_identity.features: Native solid/sketch end topology: all bodies y=-390..2; central x=+-2 cut y=-385..0. Foil-1 Sketch14 and Foil-3 Sketch12 terminal trims; Foil-2 Sketch20/22/25 short cubic and split terminal region.
cad_body_topology_identity.simplification: Long B-splines retain their existing native parameter contracts; selected end planes use the composed CAD frame. Fasteners/holes not defining the beam channel remain outside the field-critical reconstruction.

dual_stripe_l0.coordinate_definition: eta=(y-y_stripe_entrance)/signed_drift_length_L; eta_turning=1. For this frozen CAD/theory contract y_stripe_entrance=0 mm is the common endpoint of both theory Stripe functions S_i(y), not a bounding-box edge. The nominal slow drift proceeds toward negative project y; signed L carries that direction while reported |L| is positive.

theory_stripe_entrance.definition: The P2-to-Stripe hand-off plane is the y=0 endpoint of both active S_i(y) functions. S_i(0) is the baseline action term in the joint mirror period.
theory_stripe_entrance.exclusion_semantics: The CAD planar terminal extension provides mechanical continuity only. It is not a theory-profile extrapolation, a separate drift coordinate origin, or a mirror z-turning point.

dual_stripe_l0.axial_width_W_parameterization: For this fixed-mirror hardware, W is a free coordinate of the adjustable mirror-voltage solution family and is always recomputed from that trial's full coupled period. A solver may use W to parameterize the voltage family, but must enforce the computed-W equality in the same residual; W is never a second independently fixed number.

time_platform_constraint.semantics: Four user-specified time-platform derivative nodes symmetric around the nominal turning point. The paper does not publish its four node locations; this project value is user authority, not an attribution to the original paper. Before activation, each physical y=entry_y+eta_turn*L must lie within both frozen Stripe active spans and the joint Jacobian rank gate must classify the full system.

dual_stripe_l0.determination_gate: Before publishing any solved voltage, L, W, kappa, theta, or prism entrance state, evaluate the named joint residual Jacobian at the solution. Independent rank below the declared physical unknown count is underdetermined; an incompatible augmented residual rank is overdetermined; only equal independent rank permits publication of the remaining derived quantities.

current_fixed_hardware_l0_l1_problem.determination_semantics: The source state and fixed geometry are inputs, not fit coordinates. There are eight declared voltage unknowns. The first nine blocks are scalar analytic conditions; the two P1/P2-to-Stripe blocks expand into the explicitly declared position and direction components of the frozen theory hand-off interface, never into a norm or an arbitrary scalar count. The actual component-level complete Jacobian and augmented residual rank decide underdetermined, exactly-determined, or incompatible-overdetermined status. No voltage candidate may be emitted before that calculation.

prisms.parameter_provenance: 20260903 read-only Ion-Foil/prism/grounded STL section audit. Coordinates are project-frame Candidate inputs derived from the qualified top-level rigid-transform chain, never GEM literals.

ground_shields.cad_evidence: Top-level composed CAD pose: grounded-1 is one continuous body x=[-24,12], y=[33,77], z=[-100,-30] mm. Its local x=[-20,20] channel maps to project y=[35,75] mm, so the two 2-mm end lands at y=[33,35] and [75,77] are retained automatically by subtracting this finite rectangular slot from the one body; no bridge solids are added.

cad_body_topology_identity.source_features: grounded native Sketch3 triangular aperture, Sketch10 rear stepped section, faces 1/5/6/7/8/9 and 10/11 finite-x slot

cross_aperture.cad_measurement: user measurement 2026-09-03: 4-mm x width, 80-mm z opening with 57-mm end lands, 22-mm y opening; from the far Stripe side y=32, leave 4 mm then open y=6..28, leaving 3 mm to the effective Stripe-side y=3 frame edge.

cad_body_topology_identity.source_features: grounded 2 native face topology and part sketches: main body y=3..32, local stripe-side extension only |z|<=21, backing only 57<=|z|<=97; orthogonal rectangular slot union and exact triangle

prism_transport.scope: The first prism diagnostic receives a static hard-boundary seed only. It is not the two-prism injection solution. Both physical prisms precede Stripe entry in path order P1=16 then P2=17; finite 3-D shooting must replace the diagnostic before a transport or resolution claim.

entry_reference.semantics: two-zone first-time-focus plane transported toward the accelerator-exit prism

target_interface.semantics: interface/acceptance plane in the 1-mm mechanical gap before the negative inner mirror face; it constrains direction and aperture, not an unproven single y coordinate

second_prism.required_input: geometry-constrained source/focus -> P1 -> P2 -> Stripe entrance phase-space contract; P2 is not a K=25-return device

two_prism_injection_l0.semantics: CAD triangles and shields constrain mechanical clearance only. The accelerator-focus ray is frozen input. The joint Mirror-Stripe trial derives the required Stripe entrance phase-space, then finite three-dimensional P1/P2 shooting derives the actual phase-space and both prism voltages. The component-level difference is retained in the complete Jacobian; it is not an external target coordinate, a voltage scan, or a hard-boundary final claim.

stage_2_rings.purpose: five physical acceleration rings in the long second extraction region; frame aperture, centers, spacing, and voltages are all derived from the declared accelerator contract

local_pa_numerical_profile.purpose: independently refined grounded-enclosure accelerator PA; user-selected x/y/z mesh 0.25/0.25/0.1 mm resolves each 1-mm axial ring thickness with ten cells and aligns both ideal-grid planes. Mesh refinement alone does not establish timing, focal-plane, or resolution convergence.

accelerator.shape_semantics: open frame with 40-mm x outer width and 36-mm y outer height, two node-aligned ideal grids, and a 48-mm x by 44-mm y finite-wall grounded shield cavity. The asymmetric physical envelope is derived from the fixed accelerator-exit prism centreline and the CAD grounded-2 y boundary: it retains at least the declared positive y clearance instead of intersecting the long central prism shield. The exit grid spans to and contacts the inner edge of the grounded enclosure. The repeller has the declared 2-mm lateral clearance and a separate declared rear acceleration gap before the grounded rear cap; it never touches the shield shell. The exit faces project -z; its analytically derived first time-focus plane is z=0 at the declared nonzero y injection coordinate, and the accelerator body extends toward +z. The lateral enclosure is deliberately reduced from the rejected 60/72-mm provisional box; it remains a theory-derived Candidate, not a CAD-copy claim.

detector.semantics: Detector is a distinct PA instance, not an analyser-PA marker. Its active face normal is project +z and its +z face remains exactly the declared clearance before the positive grounded-mirror inner face. Its y placement is derived to retain the declared clearance from the central-prism grounded shield; it must not intersect that shield, the accelerator enclosure, or the grounded mirror.

simion.full_path_timeout_semantics: derived as this factor times target_K times the 4*terminal-plane axial round-trip path divided by the frozen nominal 4-keV ion speed; it is an explicit loss/diagnostic bound, never a performance threshold

geometry_review_isotropic.purpose: SIMION GUI geometry and voltage review only. The 33.6-mm two-zone gap cannot be exactly node-aligned at 2 mm/gu, so each ideal-grid plane is quantized by at most 1 mm and the run manifest records the actual raw-row locations. It must never be used for field convergence, timing, flight, or resolution.

coarse_flow.purpose: geometry-review PA/IOB: x=2 mm retains two raw cells across the physical 4-mm central channel; z=2 mm resolves the CAD 5-mm mirror gaps and the positive physical Stripe-to-Stripe separation; y=0.8 mm preserves native ideal-grid alignment. This is a geometry-review mesh, not a resolution or field-convergence result.

candidate_reference.purpose: subsequent Candidate numerical-reference grid after coarse functional closure
